department: Integrative Biology PhD, Charles E. Schmidt College of Science

deadline.value: Applications for fall entry are due December 11.

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact faculty before applying and after admission; core students can also do rotations.
supervisor.quote: However, applicants/acceptances must contact potential faculty directly to identify potential sponsors ahead of, and after, admission respectively

entry_route.value: A Bachelor of Science in biology or a related field is the entry requirement.
entry_route.quote: Who have completed a Bachelor of Science degree in biology or a related field

funding.value: The fetched pages do not state funding terms.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: Umbrella for the Biomedical Science (IBBS) and Environmental/Marine Science tracks, so those fields are also_fields. Neuroscience is a separate PhD and is saved as neuro. Concentrations must match a supervisor on their faculty list (dept page). Funding and GRE are not stated on the fetched pages. The department page exempts some applicants from countries with English-medium higher education (list not fetched).
